'''Saddler''' is a gambler who frequents [[The Dusty Wheel]].
== Appearance==
He has a chin that could have been used to sharpen swords, and smells like a tannery.
== Activities ==
Saddler plays dice against [[Mat Cauthon]] at The Dusty Wheel. When Mat tells him he won, he reaches for his knife, but heads off with his friends after he realizes who Mat really is.{{ref/book|13|31}}
== Trivia ==
* Saddler is named for Michael Saidler, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
